evidence: Lessons: (1) Semgrep scans .semgrep/ test fixtures as code and does not apply --exclude to explicit targets — every scan must exclude AND filter named paths (found by trying it, not by reading docs); (2) semgrep --test only reports annotated rules, so 'no test' is absence, not a status; (3) ADR ids must match by number (ADR-10 = ADR-0010 = 0010-x.md); (4) a free-text binding cell ('none yet …') is not a path; (5) zsh does not word-split unquoted variables — shell probes need ${=var}.
